title: Annie Lennox · Walking on Broken Glass
description: The complete supplied costume-party video: red hood and embroidered gown, powdered wigs, fans, candlelit party, jealous guests, corridor quarrel, spiral stairs and rescue. Original music with physical mouth-engine vocals.
